summary: Explains how to build and read PKIX certificates used for SIP over TLS, in particular how to encode a SIP domain identity in a certificate and use it to authenticate a SIP domain. It is aimed at SIP implementers and certificate issuers. It is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: A name badge for a phone-call server, so the other side can check it really belongs to the domain it claims.

questions: how to authenticate a sip domain
